name: Palladous-Mastaba
description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in a nearby asteroid belt. Travelers navigate by tectonic rift valleys and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.
Standing still, you feel the cold air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
Instruments disagree about the temporal distortion zone: mass reads one value, inertia another. Probes sent in return transmitting their own launch signals, timestamped hours early.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
